system.name: SWARM-KV
system.one_liner: a low-latency, strongly consistent, highly available disaggregated key-value store built on SWARM replication

components.name: Index
components.role: tracks locations (memory nodes and addresses) of a key's replicas

components.name: SWARM-KV Client
components.role: client library that directly accesses replicated key-value pairs using SWARM reads/writes

components.name: SWARM-Replicated Value
components.role: the set of replicas forming one key's Safe-Guess max register, spread across memory nodes

components.name: Memory Node
components.role: a disaggregated memory node holding one replica

components.name: Max Register
components.role: per-replica max register implemented via In-n-Out

components.name: InO
components.role: In-n-Out primitive providing conditional atomic update/retrieval of large buffers in one roundtrip

components.name: Timestamp Locks
components.role: locking mechanism supporting the replicated value's consistency

content.key_idea: A client caches a key's replica locations from an index and then talks directly, in a single roundtrip, to a set of disaggregated memory nodes whose In-n-Out-based max registers together form one strongly consistent, wait-free replicated value.

summary: SWARM-KV is a disaggregated key-value store built on SWARM, a wait-free replication scheme offering single-roundtrip reads/writes and linearizability. Figure 4 shows the architecture for a single key. A client library uses an Index (mapping keys to locations) to find and cache the memory nodes and addresses of a key's replicas; on first access this lookup is cached so subsequent operations skip it. The client then reads and writes the replicas directly, each implemented as a Max Register via the In-n-Out (InO) primitive on a Memory Node, supported by timestamp locks. A dashed box groups the distributed Memory Nodes as one logical SWARM-Replicated Value, and a dashed connector between the Max Registers emphasizes that, despite being spread across different memory nodes, they jointly implement one register.
summary_zh: 图4展示SWARM-KV单个键的架构：客户端先通过索引（Index）获取并缓存键的副本位置，随后直接以单次往返对分布在不同内存节点上的Max Register（基于In-n-Out实现，配合时间戳锁）进行读写，虚线框将这些节点归并为一个逻辑上的复制值。
